hypothesis: Native BF16 split-K Triton tiles may reduce projection overhead in high-batch decode.
isolated_variable: Projection tile and split-K scheduling only; unchanged BF16 inputs/weights/output and FP32 accumulation; no lossy quantization.
controls: GPU6, OMP4, B64 actual prompt-prefilled all-layer inputs, native FP8 experts and BF16 GDN, same reference and candidate weights, no cache flush; all-weight projection sequence complements hot shape tuning.
success: Finite output and RRMS<0.003 versus existing projection on every captured input before all-weight timings; eventual full decode/state and service checks required.
stop: Any selected real-input check failure, compile/runtime error or GPU6 interference; no change to frozen service acceptance gates.
